title: National Study of Private Ownership of Firearms in the United States, 1994
description:
This data collection consists of a survey of private
 ownership of firearms by adults in the United States. Respondents who
 both did and did not own firearms were included. The variables cover
 topics such as the number and type of guns owned privately, methods
 of, and reasons for, firearms acquisition, the storage and carrying of
 guns, the defensive use of firearms against criminal attackers, and
 reasons for and against firearm ownership. Basic demographic
variables include sex, age, education, and employment.
